        🤖 My agents — ⭐ = main agent · switch on as many as you like

        🔌 Connections — let an agent use another app

        What is this? Agents can already search the web and X. A connection lets an agent also use an app of yours — Google Calendar, Gmail, Sheets, Maps, GitHub…

        Bot or app? The agent is the bot that does the job. The connection is just the plug into the app. "MCP" is only the name of the plug type — you never have to touch it.

        Do I need one? No. Only if you want an agent to read your calendar, send an email draft, check a sheet, and so on.

        Easiest way: ⚡ Zapier → add the app actions you want on zapier.com/mcp → copy your link → paste it below → tick which agents may use it.

          🎨 Image API
          
              
          

          
              ☁️ Comfy Cloud
              
          
              Runs your own ComfyUI workflows on cloud.comfy.org. Pick ☁️ ComfyUI in the Studio to use them.
              
          
              
          
              
          
              
          
              In ComfyUI: Workflow → Export (API), then add that file here or drop it on the window. Familiar finds the prompt, negative, seed, size and input-image nodes on its own.
              
        
              

        
              
          🎙️ Dictation
          
          
              
          
          
          

          
              🩺 Mic doctor
              
          
          
              
          
              
            
            
            
          
              
          
              
          
              Free alternative on Windows: click the chat box and press Win + H.
              
        
              

        
              
          🔊 Voice — she talks out loud
          
          
              
          
              
          
          
              
            
            
          
              
          
          
              
          
              Each character keeps her own voice pick. 🔊 on any of her messages reads just that one. Paid voices log to 📊 API usage.
              
        
              

        
              
          ☁️ Google Drive
          
              Keeps every character organized in Hub → Characters → her: profile, card, memory, chats, faces, poses, pictures, GIFs and videos. It writes into your Google Drive for desktop folder and Drive uploads it.
              
          
              
          
              
          
          
          
              
          
              
        
              

        
              
          🏠 The Hub
          
              Let your Hub (home page) show her — name, mood, last line — and open her with one click. It only answers on this computer, only with your private key. Nothing goes online.
              
          
          
          
              
          
              
          
              
          
              The Hub opens her with familiar://open (or familiar://open?tab=looks). Links can only open a tab — never send messages or change settings.
              
        
              

        
              
          🔗 Grok Bot
          
              Set her up as a bot in xAI's Grok Bot app: copy the brief and paste it when you create the bot.
              
          
              
            
            
          
              
          
              Live bridge — beta
              
          
              Pick a folder that syncs to Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive. Familiar keeps her brief and memory there. If your Grok Bot can reach that drive, it reads her memory and can add new memories to the -inbox.md file, which Familiar imports.
              
          
              
          
          
              
        
              

        
              
          💌 Check-ins
          
              
            
              She reaches out sometimesA simple timer on your computer. She pops up with one line, then waits. No agents, nothing running in between.
